leads.title: Obergefell v. Hodges
leads.documents: U.S. Supreme Court ruling that legalized same-sex marriage nationwide, including South Dakota, holding denial of marriage rights to same-sex couples unconstitutional.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: decided June 26, 2015; cited as basis for marriage recognition in South Dakota.

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County, consolidated with Altitude Express, Inc. v. Zarda and R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes Inc. v. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
leads.documents: U.S. Supreme Court ruling that workplace discrimination on basis of sexual orientation or gender identity is sex discrimination under Title VII, protecting LGBT employees.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: decided June 15, 2020.

leads.title: Rosenbrahn v. Daugaard
leads.documents: Federal lawsuit by six same-sex couples against South Dakota officials seeking marriage rights; U.S. District Judge Karen Schreier ruled Jan 12, 2015 that South Dakota deprived plaintiffs of fundamental right to marry, stayed pending appeal.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: filed May 22, 2014 by attorney Joshua A. Newville; arguments Oct 17, 2014; motion to dismiss denied Nov 12; Attorney General Marty Jackley response cited.

leads.title: House Bill 1080 - South Dakota Legislature (2023) gender-affirming care ban
leads.documents: State law banning gender-affirming healthcare for trans people under 18, requiring taper off prior treatment by Dec 31, 2023, and allowing lawsuits until age 25 or within 3 years of awareness of injury.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: passed Legislature Feb 2023, signed by Gov. Kristi Noem Feb 13; Section 6 quoted on pre-July 1, 2023 treatment.

leads.title: Supreme Court of South Dakota - March 2026 birth certificate ruling
leads.documents: State supreme court ruling banning transgender individuals from changing sex on birth certificate unless error made at birth; contrasts with prior Office of Vital Records / Dept. of Public Safety process allowing change via court order or physician affidavit.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: March 2026 ruling described in Identity documents section.

leads.title: S.J. 746 (2017) - South Dakota adoption religious exemption law
leads.documents: State law permitting adoption agencies to refuse placements that violate agency's religious or moral convictions, affecting LGBTQ prospective parents.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: passed into law May 2017.

leads.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act (2009)
leads.documents: Federal hate-crimes law covering sexual orientation and gender identity, allowing federal prosecution in South Dakota where state law does not address hate crimes based on gender identity or sexual orientation.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: signed 2009 by President Barack Obama.

leads.title: Oglala Sioux Tribal Council hate crime legislation - September 2019
leads.documents: Tribal hate-crime legislation protecting LGBT and two-spirit individuals within Oglala Sioux jurisdiction.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: passed with 14 votes in favor, 2 against and 1 abstention.

leads.title: South Dakota transgender sports ban - Executive Order (2021) and 2022 law
leads.documents: Enforcement machinery barring transgender athletes from female school sports teams; Gov. Noem refused broader 2021 bill over NCAA concerns but signed executive order, then signed 2022 bill effective July 1, 2022.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: March 19, 2021 refusal/executive order; Jan-Feb 2022 legislative passage; signed Feb 4, 2022; ACLU threatened federal lawsuit noted.

leads.title: Human Rights Campaign reporting on HB 1108 (2019) / The Transformation Project lawsuit (2024)
leads.documents: HRC institutional assessment that HB 1108 would bar K-7 public schools from instructing on gender identity and prevent teachers acknowledging/supporting transgender students; and 2024 transgender-rights organization The Transformation Project discrimination lawsuit win against state.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text. Citation detail visible: HB 1108 passed House Feb 12, 2019, failed Senate before sine die March 29, 2019; 2024 Transformation Project suit won.
